title: Novel Algorithm → G-Code Pipeline
brief: Transform novel algorithm segment arrays into verified, post-processed G-code for major CNC controllers. End-to-end: segments → interpolation → G-code blocks → verification.

units.title: SegmentInterpolatorEngine — Novel segments → motion blocks
units.description: Convert NovelToolpathResult.segments[] into CNC motion blocks. Linear interpolation (G01) for straight segments, circular (G02/G03) fitting with Bézier→arc approximation (tolerance-based), helical interpolation (G02/G03 with Z). Handles: feed_mmmin, rpm, ae_mm, ap_mm per segment. Inserts tool changes, coolant on/off (M08/M09), spindle commands (M03/M04/M05). Applies PTDC compensation offsets to coordinates.

units.title: NovelPostProcessorBridge — Controller-specific G-code output
units.description: Bridge between SegmentInterpolator output and existing PostProcessorEngine. Maps novel algorithm metadata to post-processor context: controller dialect (Fanuc/Siemens/Heidenhain/Mazak/Haas), 5-axis format (RTCP/TCP, BC/AC axes), canned cycles, subprogram calls. Embeds novel algorithm name + physics summary as G-code comments. Supports: Fanuc (G43.4 RTCP), Siemens (CYCLE800, TRAORI), Heidenhain (M128 TCPM), Mazak (G43.4), Haas (G234 DWO).

units.title: ProgramStructureEngine — Complete NC program assembly
units.description: Assemble complete NC programs from novel algorithm results: program header (O-number, date, material, algorithm used), safety block (G90 G40 G80 G17/G18/G19), tool calls with H/D offsets, work offset (G54-G59), approach/retract moves, cut segments, tool change blocks, program end (M30). Auto-generates setup sheet data. Handles multi-operation programs (rough→finish with different novel algorithms).

units.title: GCodeVerificationEngine — Syntax + physics validation
units.description: Verify generated G-code: (1) syntax validation per controller dialect, (2) motion continuity (no jumps > retract height), (3) feed rate limits vs machine capability, (4) spindle speed limits, (5) rapid traverse safety (Z-first retract), (6) work envelope bounds check, (7) tool length/diameter vs collision data. Uses existing GCodeSafetyAnalyzerEngine rules + novel-algorithm-specific checks (PTDC compensation bounds, VCER retract heights, TGAR thermal zone transitions).
exit_conditions: Reject invalid programs with clear errors

units.title: EndToEndPipelineEngine — One-call feature→G-code
units.description: Orchestration engine: takes (feature_description, material, machine, tool, priority) → returns {gcode: string, algorithm_used: string, physics_summary: string, cycle_time_sec: number, setup_sheet: object}. Chains: FeatureToZone → AlgorithmSelector → NovelCompute → SegmentInterpolator → PostProcessor → Verification. Single dispatcher action: 'novel_generate_program'. Falls back to conventional strategy if novel algorithm fails.
